criteria.title: Historical revision recovery without claiming unsaved edits
requireTestIds: M04 recovery: restore committed revision; refuse while form dirty
criteria.observation: File → Recover revision restores a committed snapshot; dirty forms refuse recovery.

criteria.title: Atomic build-ID offline cache
requireTestIds: precaches atomic build and reopens offline from IndexedDB
prompts reload after save when a waiting build update is ready
criteria.observation: Service worker caches one build set; offline reopen works; update prompts after save.

criteria.title: Schema migration with original retention
requireTestIds: M04 migration: 0.9.0 imports, retains original, unknown schema refused
criteria.observation: 0.9.0→1.0.0 migrates with hash parity; originals retained; unknown majors refused.

criteria.title: Corrupt snapshot, Worker crash, persistence denied
requireTestIds: corrupt latest snapshot recovers verified history revision
model Worker crash restores last confirmed in-memory model
persistence denied warns without blocking export
criteria.observation: Corrupt projects pointer falls back to verified history; Worker crash restores memory model; persistence denial warns.

criteria.title: Quota failure and single-writer lease
requireTestIds: storage quota failure is explicit and downloads survive
single writer lock protects the second tab
criteria.observation: STORAGE_QUOTA keeps export available; second tab opens read-only under the lease.

criteria.title: Escaped reports and CSV formula neutralization
criteria.observation: HTML labels escape; CSV formula cells are neutralized before download.

criteria.title: Calculation record and export/import equivalence
requireTestIds: M04 record: export/import equivalence and report matches displayed results
criteria.observation: Project/report/CSV export round-trip preserves hash and displayed tip results.

limitations: Fail-closed parent recorder; memory soak and M05 catalogue work remain out of scope.
